plain: To force someone to act through threats or pressure

webster.text: To restrain by force; to keep from acting, or transgressing, particularly by moral force, as by law or authority; to repress.

example.quote: It has rarely been attempted to be employed, but against the weaker members; and in most instances attempts to coerce the refractory and disobedient have been the signals of bloody wars, in which one half of the confederacy has displayed its banners against the other half.
